utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Kira, I heard the repair drive’s shaping up nicely—folks are already setting aside tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds promising, but who’s actually confirmed they’re bringing tools and parts?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, Milo’s bringing a toolbox and some fasteners, and Priya said she’s got spare bike tubes and patch kits set aside.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, I’m telling everyone we’re doing the repair drive soon, so let me know the plan and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m still getting the plan together, but I’ll send you the details as soon as I’ve got them straight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good—once you send me the details, I’ll pass the plan along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with pickups this afternoon if we’ve got the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d help a lot—I'm out running errands now, but if the list’s ready by this afternoon, I can coordinate with you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—send me the list when it’s set, and I’ll handle pickups this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help a bit if you tell me what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’m keeping a list, and right now we still need help patching the fence and sorting tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at the fence first, and after that I can help sort the tools if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works just fine—we can slot you in between pickup and drop-off, or give you a task you can do from home if that’s easier.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that helps a lot—I’m free after drop-off until about 2, so if there’s a sorting or phone task in that window, I can take it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Oren — let’s keep the repair drive simple and organized, and decide who’s bringing what first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Eli — right, simple is good. I can bring my toolbox and a fold-up table, unless I’m forgetting something obvious.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a solid start, Oren. I’ll bring labels, a sign-up sheet, and a box for small parts, and then we can make a short checklist for the rest.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m getting folks together for the repair drive this weekend—want to come by and bring anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe, but I’m a little worried about how crowded it’ll get and where everyone’s supposed to park. What time are people showing up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally fair—people will start drifting in around 10, and I’m telling everyone to use the side street and keep the driveway clear so it doesn’t get too packed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—are folks still collecting tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, we’re still collecting tools, and a few neighbors have already dropped some off. If you’d like, I can tell you what we still need most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d help a lot—what are folks saying you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we start collecting anything, can you remind me which repairs are highest priority and who’s already volunteered?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Top priority is the broken porch steps and the leaky roof at the center, and so far Joel said he can handle carpentry while Priya volunteered to organize supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — porch steps and the center’s roof come first, with Joel on carpentry and Priya on supplies. Do we know yet who can take lead on the roof work?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive, just not for long.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably swing by a bit late, but I can still lend a hand for a while.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s alright, even a little helps. I’ll be there early and do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my ladder and toolbox to the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps—what time can you get there, and is your ladder tall enough for gutter work?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can get there around 9, and yeah, the ladder’s tall enough for gutter work on a one-story place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know exactly where the repair drive is set up, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it’s over by the community center parking lot, but I’d double-check the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, I’ll check the flyer and confirm whether it’s at the community center parking lot exactly.
